title: Solve, Not Show Off
excerpt: The best solution is not to show off, but to solve the problem.
body:
It is easy to build for admiration. Complex pattern, layered architecture, visible clearness, they signal intelligency and reliability, but not always value.

 Solving the problem rarely look impressive. It simplifies what was unnecessary complexity.

 Showcasing skill is tempting, especially when the solution become a stage. But the real systems are not built form admired - they are build to solve.

 A clean solution does not demand recognition. It holds under use, adapts under change, and remains understandable over time.

 The question is not whether to show off.
 It is how you solve the problem without compromising on quality.

 Solve the problem, leave the performance and ego out of it
